judgements.justification: B's Reviewer_DgEc edited its rating to 7 on 2021-08-31 with no comment while its text still calls the work not 'enough to warranty an acceptance', and B's AC counted the panel as shifted to a mean of 7.
B's AC set aside Reviewer_456H's 4 because it never replied and accepted on three 7s, while A's equally silent Reviewer_Wt3P's 4 counted toward rejection.
Both committees had reviewers at 7 (A's aK3Q at confidence 5, B's three 7s), and no reviewer in either rated above 7.
No reviewer in either committee admitted reading only part of the paper; B's 456H was confused about the executor but did not say it stopped reading.

A's Reviewer_kENU (and EBwR) read the work from the task-and-motion-planning tradition, questioned its framing as program synthesis, and kept 4 partly for weak grounding in planning work, while B's reviewers accepted the program-synthesis framing.
B's AC gave a stated, if thin, case for the spotlight (the paper is 'pretty cool' and its quality 'warrants it being an exemplar'), so the tier is not without a stated assessment.

kENU's baseline concerns (Relational below End-to-end) were resolved by new runs it accepted, and B's reviewers (F1k5, SkvM) also knew the related literature, so no expertise gap on baselines separates the outcomes.
A's meta-review did not misstate its reviewers' final positions; B's AC's privileged-information slip concerns the paper, not reviewers, and points toward the higher decision.
Neither committee objected that the paper is of interest to too few readers or belongs at another venue.
The misreading detractor (456H) sat in B, which still gave a spotlight; A, without such a detractor, rejected.

Both committees received new results in the rebuttal (A: full-map baselines, module accuracies; B: explore-then-plan and non-deterministic runs), and no stated score rise followed from B-only results.
A's confidence-5 reviewer aK3Q (7) was outweighed partly by careful critics kENU and EBwR whose factual points held, and A's AC leaned on its own novelty reading rather than the mean of ratings.
EBwR's neural-controller request and 6-to-5 cut came during the discussion and the authors answered it; the unanswered TD-VAE/POMCP objection came from A's AC, not a reviewer.

B's DgEc rated 7 while writing the work is not enough for acceptance, whereas A's kENU called the approach 'a worthwhile contribution on its own' yet rated 4, so ratings diverged more than the verbal assessments.
kENU's remark that the 'user gives only a goal' claim is overstated was a minor point, not a reason the AC used to cap the outcome.
Neither committee's reviewers converged on flat marginal-accept ratings; A's were mostly 4s and B's were 7s with one 4.
